android.desc:
Talk is an Android app designed to redefine your calling experience with a refreshing, user-centric approach. Already trusted by over 2.5 million users, Talk combines simplicity, creativity, and powerful features to make every call enjoyable and efficient.

🚫 Effortless Spam Blocking & DND Enrollment
Say goodbye to spam calls! Talk simplifies spam reporting with a single touch, seamlessly integrating with TRAI’s streamlined complaint process. Enroll in Do Not Disturb (DND) service and block spam effortlessly.

📅 Smart Call History & Insights
Relive past conversations with a sleek calendar-based call history. View call details, including network strength, to make data-backed decisions about your network quality.

💬 Multilingual Contact Indexing
Never struggle to find contacts saved in various languages! Talk supports Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, and more, offering precise contact search and organization for everyone.

⭐ Intelligent Favorites & Reminders
Let Talk intelligently identify your most-called contacts and display them right on your home screen. Stay connected with reminders when you haven’t spoken to your favorite people in a while.

📖 Organized Contacts
Navigate your contact list like never before. With an alphabetical scroll and contact count display, managing your network feels effortless and intuitive.

🎨 Avatars for Fun Interactions
Add a playful touch to your calls with charming avatars! Experience a delightful and colorful interface every time you receive or make a call.Make calling personal! Choose from vibrant avatar packs like animals, pets, moods, and more for your call screen.

Talk is designed to make your calling experience better, simpler, and more enjoyable. Whether you’re tired of spam calls, struggling with multilingual contacts, or just looking for a dialer that understands you, Talk is here to help.

Download Talk today and join millions who’ve transformed the way they connect!

We made an android dialer app with novel UX approach towards 
1. call history
2. contacts  
3. call screens
4. date minders

Call screens and contacts are made more fun using random robohash avatars (https://robohash.org/) for every call/contacts.

Talk does not harvest your address book/contacts.

We are looking for feedback/comments. For detail info on other features, please take a look at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.littlebit.phone
